title: Trove purchase line item
description: One line of finance/purchases/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a single purchased line item, grouped into an order at read time by order_id. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local order/purchase date (sources give a date; write local midnight)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (order id + line index, transaction id, …)

order_id.description: groups the line items of one order/receipt; the read-time grouping key

merchant.description: where it was bought (Amazon, the Apple storefront, the retailer)

item.description: item description / title (the app name, product title, grocery item)

unit_price.description: price per unit (currency is the separate currency field)

amount.description: line total (unit_price × qty, before order-level shipping/tax; currency is the separate currency field)

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; omit when the source doesn't state it

url.description: product/item link, when the source gives one

status.description: source-native fulfilment state (delivered, shipped, refunded, canceled)

shipment.description: shipping detail when present (tracking, carrier, delivered timestamp, …)

extra.description: everything source-specific (ASIN, tax, payment instrument, storefront, subscription flag, loyalty id, …)
